道具是给姿势当依托的：坐的、扶的、靠的、踩的。它归整个场景，不跟着哪个角色；「保: Props give a pose something to rest on: things to sit on, hold, lean against or step on. They belong to the whole scene, not to one character; "Save scene" includes them, "Save config" doesn't. Click a prop in the 3D view to select it, then drag the arrows to move, the rings to rotate and the cubes to resize (hold Shift for 5 cm and 15° steps; keys: W move, E rotate, R scale, Delete to remove). Undo and redo treat prop changes and character changes as one sequence, in the order you made them.

「{who}」整个人正跟着「{name}」（坐在、站在它上面），它不能再跟着{p: {who} is following "{name}" with the whole body (sitting or standing on it), so it cannot also follow the {part}
「{name}」放下了，留在现在的地方；{part}还抓在它上面，挪它、转它{p: "{name}" is put down and stays where it is; the {part} still holds it, and follows when you move or turn it.
「{name}」跟着{part}了：拖这只脚、拖身体、挪角色，它都跟着走、跟着转: "{name}" now follows the {part}: drag this foot, drag the body or move the character and it moves and turns along. To leave it in place, untick "Prop follows this foot".
「{name}」拿在{part}上了：拖这只手、拖身体、挪角色、换姿势，它都跟着: "{name}" is now carried in the {part}: drag this hand, drag the body, move the character or change the pose and it moves and turns along. To leave it in place, untick "Prop follows this hand".
勾上：拖这只脚、拖身体、挪角色，道具都跟着走、跟着转。不勾：道具不动，脚踩在它上: Ticked: drag this foot, drag the body or move the character and the prop moves and turns along. Unticked: the prop stays put and the foot stands on it. Neither the foot nor the prop moves at the moment you switch
勾上是拿着：拖这只手、拖身体、挪角色、换姿势，道具都跟着走、跟着转。不勾是道具不: Ticked means carrying: drag this hand, drag the body, move the character or change the pose and the prop moves and turns along. Unticked means the prop stays put and the hand holds on to it (like a grab rail on a bus). Neither the hand nor the prop moves at the moment you switch
松开以后道具留在现在的地方，不再跟着走: After letting go the prop stays where it is and no longer follows
{part}伸直了，拉住了「{name}」；再往外拖，这只手就松开。: {part} is fully stretched and is holding "{name}" back; drag further and that hand lets go.
{part}够不着「{name}」了，松开了。: {part} could no longer reach "{name}" and let go.
拖这只手，「{name}」绕着{main}转；拖{main}，它带着这只手走。: Drag this hand and "{name}" swings around the {main}; drag the {main} and it takes this hand along.
「{name}」跟着{main}走，这只手跟着它；拖这只手是在它上面换个地方抓。: "{name}" follows the {main} and this hand follows the prop; dragging this hand just moves its grip to another spot on it.
这个身体上没找到胸口，抱不了。: No chest was found on this body, so it cannot hug a prop.
「{who}」抱着「{name}」了：弯腰、转身、拖胯、挪角色，它都跟着胸口走。: "{who}" is now hugging "{name}": bend, twist, drag the hips or move the character and it follows the chest. Drag a hand onto it to hold it and the hand follows it too. To stop hugging, click "Detach" under "Attached to it".
「{name}」放下了，留在现在的地方。: "{name}" is put down and stays where it is.
抱在怀里、顶在身前的东西用：先把它摆到身前再点，之后它跟着胸口走——弯腰、转身、: For things held against the body: place the prop in front of the chest first, then click. From then on it follows the chest when the character bends, twists or moves. Drag the hands onto it to hold it and they follow it too
这里没有抓着、带着道具: Nothing is held or carried here
「{who}」的{part}拿着「{name}」了：拖这只手、拖身体、挪角色，它: "{who}" is now carrying "{name}" in the {part}: drag that hand, drag the body or move the character and it comes along. To put it down, click that hand and untick "Prop follows this hand".
「{who}」两手端着「{name}」了：它跟着右手走，左手抓在它上面；拖手、拖: "{who}" is now carrying "{name}" in both hands: it follows the right hand and the left hand holds onto it; dragging a hand, dragging the body or moving the character takes it along.
「{who}」把「{name}」抱在胸前了：弯腰、转身、挪角色，它都跟着胸口走。: "{who}" is now hugging "{name}" against the chest: bend, twist or move the character and it follows the chest. To stop hugging, click "Detach" under "Attached to it".
「{who}」把「{name}」举过头顶了：它跟着右手走，左手抓在它上面；拖手、: "{who}" is now holding "{name}" above the head: it follows the right hand and the left hand holds onto it; dragging a hand, dragging the body or moving the character takes it along.
「{name}」跟着{part}走了：拖它、拖身体、挪角色，道具都带着。: "{name}" now follows the {part}: drag it, drag the body or move the character and the prop comes along.
点「拿着」「两手端着」「抱着」「举过头顶」是反过来：道具到角色手上，之后跟着人走: "Carry", "Carry in both hands", "Hug" and "Lift overhead" work the other way round: the prop comes to the character's hands and follows the character from then on. While posing, drag a hand up to a prop and it snaps on and grabs it.
一只手扶（握）在这件道具上：够得着就原地伸手、别的姿势不动，够不着就走过去站好再: Puts one hand on this prop (or grips it): if it is within reach the figure just reaches out and the rest of the pose stays; if not, it walks over, stands straight and then reaches. For a horizontal bar overhead (a bus handrail) it stands underneath and reaches up to grip it. Afterwards that hand holds the prop: move or turn it and the hand goes with it. Click again for the other hand
一只手拿着这件道具：杆、棍子是握着，别的是托在手心上。角色站在原地，道具到手上来: Carries this prop in one hand: poles and sticks are gripped, anything else rests on the palm. The character stays where it stands and the prop comes to the hand, then follows that hand. Click again for the other hand
两只手一左一右端着这件道具，在身前；杆是横着握。角色站在原地，道具到手上来，之后: Carries this prop in front of the body with one hand on each side; a pole is gripped horizontally. The character stays where it stands and the prop comes to the hands, then follows them
把这件道具抱在胸前，两只手搂着它。之后它跟着胸口走：弯腰、转身、挪角色都带着: Hugs this prop against the chest with both arms around it. From then on it follows the chest: bending, twisting and moving the character all take it along
两只手把这件道具举过头顶；杆是横着举。角色站在原地，道具到手上来，之后跟着手走: Lifts this prop above the head with both hands; a pole is held horizontally. The character stays where it stands and the prop comes to the hands, then follows them
这件道具太大，一只手拿不了：用「两手端着」: This prop is too big for one hand: use "Carry in both hands"
这件道具太宽，两只手够不到两边: This prop is too wide for both hands to reach its sides
这个角色正坐在、站在这件道具上，拿不起来：先在「连着它的」里解开: This character is sitting or standing on this prop and cannot pick it up: detach it under "Attached to it" first
这个角色没有这只手（脚）: This character has no such hand or foot
够不着：先把道具或者角色挪近一点: Out of reach: move the prop or the character a little closer first
{part}没有握着杆：贴在面上、扣在棱上的手没有正手、反手之分: {part} is not gripping a bar: a hand laid on a surface or hooked over an edge has no overhand or underhand grip
{part}在这里换不了握法：换过去那一面握不住。把手沿着杆挪一点再试: {part} cannot switch grip here: it cannot get a grip on the other side. Move the hand a little along the bar and try again
